note: Themes of one's own: Design > Save Theme keeps the deck's look (its theme's background and decorations, the colours it shows and its fonts) as a theme of the gallery, for this deck and the next. The saved themes are kept with the app's settings (persist), not in a deck, so every deck can use them.

saveTheme.to: {{concat(state.ownThemes ?? [], [{ id: 'own' + (length(state.ownThemes ?? []) + 1), name: 'My Theme ' + (length(state.ownThemes ?? []) + 1), background: computed.theme.background, colors: computed.colors, variants: [{}], decor: computed.theme.decor, titleDecor: computed.theme.titleDecor, fonts: state.deck.fonts ?? { heading: 'default', body: 'default' } }])}}
